title: AssignSharedWorkflowRequest
description: Assign or unassign one shared credentialing group

assignedTo.description: Analyst for ordinary members; null or absent unassigns

onshoreAssignedTo.description: Analyst for onshore-only members, when the group has any

reason.description: Optional reason, carried to the audit row

tenantId.description: Tenant written by the enqueuer; asserted against the tenant-id header

expectedAssignedTo.description: The analyst this group held when the task was enqueued. Stamped by the dispatcher so a retried older task cannot undo a newer assignment: Cloud Tasks does not preserve order, and retries make it less ordered still.

hasExpectedAssignedTo.description: Whether expectedAssignedTo was stamped at all. Needed because null is a real expectation -- the group was unassigned -- and absent is not.

expectedMembersAssignedTo.description: The member-level analysts the group held when the task was enqueued. Compared as a set, because R15 legitimately splits one group across two analysts and a member-level reassignment can leave assignedTo untouched.
